title: charts start with story
rule: Start with the story, not the chart. Pick the relationship (comparison, trend, proportion, distribution, correlation) first. No chart if a single callout number or a table is clearer, the set is too small, or the chart needs heavy explanation. Not for decoration.
pass_when: Chart type matches the relationship; no chart when a callout or table is clearer, the set is too small, or it needs heavy explanation.
fail_when: Decorative chart; chart for a single number that a callout would carry.
apply_when: Table or card grid for this data
not_when: Not for controls inside a form, or density on a form.
agent_hint: Start with the story, not the chart.
description: Start with the story, not the chart. Chart type matches the relationship. It fails when Decorative chart.
